dump_results_to_json: dump keypoint detection results to a COCO style JSON file separated by body, foot, face, and hand regions
evaluate_keypoints_with_cocoapi: run COCO-style keypoint evaluation for body, foot, face, left hand, right hand, and whole body Goliath keypoints
